title: Food Systems whole-corpus processing lifecycle
description: Strict fail-closed lifecycle record. AI processing, owner review, independent validation, rights, publication, and subject-coverage promotion are separate gates.

completedAt.description: Checkpoint time interpreted under the parent run's timeEvidence declaration; it is not necessarily a provider execution timestamp.

modelVersionState.description: Whether modelVersion is an exact provider-exposed version or the required non-exposure sentinel.

modelVersion.description: Exact version when exposed; otherwise exactly runtime_not_exposed.

timeEvidence.description: Declares whether timestamps came from the provider or are only a coordinator-observed request window.

timeEvidenceExplanation.description: Plain explanation of the timestamp evidence and its limitations.
